question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution: The correct answer is '**strength**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given passage is about the 'Human Skeleton System'. • The most appropriate word for the first blank is 'strength'. • It means 'the quality of being physically strong; the amount of this quality that you have'. (शारीरिक बल, शक्ति, ताक़त; किसी में शारीरिक बल या शक्ति की मात्रा) • *Example: He pulled with all his **strength** but the rock would not move.* • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **value**: the amount of money that something is worth. [(किसी वस्‍तु का) मूल्‍य, क़ीमत] • **length**: the size of something from one end to the other; how long something is. (किसी वस्‍तु की लंबाई) • **ability**: the mental or physical power or skill that makes it possible to do something. (किसी कार्य को पूरा करने की मानसिक या शारीरिक शक्ति; योग्‍यता, क्षमता) • As per the above definition, we find that the correct answer is **Option 3.** Correct Passage:__ *The human skeleton is the **internal **framework of our body. It gives shape and support to the body. Besides, it provides protection, makes blood cells, stores minerals and regulates hormones. The spinal cord is an important part of our body. The ribcage protects our lungs and heart. To increase the **strength** of our bones, we should include calcium in our diet. All our (5)______ organs are protected by this skeletal system.* 46:Tcd6, The correct answer is '**vital**'.
